# Real stories – Adaptive IVR agent

Oct 28, 2026 · @Rickard Åberg

True stories from calling public agencies, for the pitch. Each one points to a goal in Doc. No staff names.

## The AirPods call (goal 5: make the wait easy)

On my first day as unemployed, I called {{AGENCY}} at 8:00 while out walking, using AirPods. When I finally reached a person, she asked me to come closer to the phone. I said I was wearing AirPods. She told me to call back later and hung up.

**What it shows:** today you can't wait in the queue while you're out – and the person on the other end is not always professional.
